definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony celebrating a marriage, encompassing the ritual and celebratory aspects.

examples.japanese: {婚礼|こんれい}の{儀|ぎ}が{行|おこな}われた。
{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{婚礼|こんれい}{衣装|いしょう}を{身|み}にまとった。
{神社|じんじゃ}での{婚礼|こんれい}は、{厳|おごそ}かな{雰囲気|ふんいき}の{中|なか}で{執|と}り{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The wedding at the shrine was conducted in a solemn atmosphere.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary word for a wedding ceremony. While {結婚式|けっこんしき} is the everyday term, {婚礼|こんれい} carries a more traditional and ceremonial tone. It is commonly seen in formal writing, historical contexts, and descriptions of traditional Japanese or Western-style weddings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚礼|こんれい}の{儀|ぎ}: wedding rites
- {婚礼|こんれい}{衣装|いしょう}: wedding attire
- {婚礼|こんれい}{料理|りょうり}: wedding feast
- {婚礼|こんれい}{道具|どうぐ}: wedding trousseau

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}: wedding ceremony — the standard everyday term
- {挙式|きょしき}: holding a wedding ceremony — focuses on the act of conducting the ceremony
- {祝言|しゅうげん}: wedding celebration — an older, more literary term
